_note: The data schema (Phase 2 step 4b, docs/architecture/data-schema.md). Hand-maintained: a new key goes into its kind here. files.<file>.paths: which dictionary is which kind ('*' = any key of an id map, '[]' = each element of a list); idmaps: dictionaries whose keys are ids; maps: dictionaries whose keys name ids (or free names) and whose values share one type; skip: not looked into. kinds.<kind>.keys.<key>: [type] or [type, default] or [type, default, {variant: default}] - the default is what a read through GameData.opt gets when the entry lacks the key; required: keys every entry must have; refs: keys naming ids ('key[]' = a list of ids; targets ability, status, item, enemy, affinity, rune, word, station, craft_skill).
